execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."application_status_history" (
  "changed_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "job_application_id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "application_status_history_status_check_989b4fe8" CHECK ("status" IN ('applied', 'screening', 'interview', 'offer', 'rejected', 'withdrawn', 'no_response'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."contact" (
  "email" character varying(255),
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "job_application_id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "phone" character varying(50),
  "role" character varying(100),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."country" (
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "iso_code" character varying(2) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."document" (
  "document_type" text NOT NULL,
  "file_path" text NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "original_filename" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "uploaded_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "document_document_type_check_3f540265" CHECK ("document_type" IN ('cv', 'cover_letter'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."document_has_skill" (
  "document_id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "skill_id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("document_id", "skill_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."interview_round" (
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "job_application_id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "outcome" text DEFAULT 'scheduled' NOT NULL,
  "round_type" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "scheduled_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "interview_round_outcome_check_c5b0c77b" CHECK ("outcome" IN ('scheduled', 'passed', 'failed', 'cancelled'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."job_application" (
  "applied_at" date NOT NULL,
  "country_id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "cover_letter_document_id" character(36),
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current_status" text DEFAULT 'applied' NOT NULL,
  "cv_document_id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "organization_id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "posting_url" text,
  "source" character varying(100),
  "title" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "job_application_current_status_check_df490497" CHECK ("current_status" IN ('applied', 'screening', 'interview', 'offer', 'rejected', 'withdrawn', 'no_response'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."job_application_has_skill" (
  "job_application_id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "skill_id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("job_application_id", "skill_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."organization" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "notes" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "website_url" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."organization_in_country" (
  "country_id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "organization_id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("organization_id", "country_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."skill" (
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(150) NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
